description: This file defines classes and functions for audit trail logging in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including rules, logs, log lines, and a proxy for object method call interception.

classes.name: audittrail_rule
classes.description: Defines audit trail rules for object access logging, including methods to subscribe/unsubscribe rules.

classes.name: audittrail_log
classes.description: Represents audit trail logs, storing user actions on objects with timestamps.

classes.name: audittrail_log_line
classes.description: Represents individual log lines detailing field changes within a log entry.

classes.name: audittrail_objects_proxy
classes.description: Proxy class that intercepts object method calls to log read/write/create/unlink actions based on rules.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Activates logging rules for a specific object, creating associated actions.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Deactivates logging rules, removing associated actions and resetting rule state.

methods.name: log_fct
methods.description: Wraps object method calls to log create, write, read, and unlink actions according to rules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides object method execution to insert logging logic based on active rules.

methods.name: get_value_text
methods.description: Retrieves human-readable text for field values, especially for relational fields.

methods.name: create_log_line
methods.description: Creates log line entries for field changes.
